title: Аметистовый грот
palette: Violet and midnight indigo rock, luminous lavender amethyst, restrained cyan mineral pools, silver-blue fungi. No green garden or cream building.
terrain: A lopsided faceted open-ravine island with one large open-cut mineral ravine on one side and a lower mineral shelf extending far to the other. Thick connected purple rock mass, not a round platform.
landmarks: Three substantial amethyst crystal clusters, one very short thick stone bridge-like arch with daylight on both sides, a shallow cyan mineral pool, chunky silver-blue mushrooms.
road: Broad muted plum stone paving with a pale lavender mineral seam along one edge, rock shoulders on both sides.
journey: Bend down into the open-cut grotto, pass below its short thick arch, emerge along a mineral pool, change curve direction between crystal outcrops, then cross an interior saddle. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Stylized faceted minerals and smooth sculpted cave walls with controlled soft gemstone glow.
architecture: One low indigo-stone radio research workshop on the NORTHWEST mineral ledge with lavender metal roof and chunky silver/brass vent; two squat crystal-cut courier homes on the SOUTHEAST shelf, short thick antenna forks and circular speaker grilles. Facades visible in OPEN ravine, never long enclosed cave architecture.
